prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 56-72 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a regal mummy standing upright, wrapped in yellowed bandages edged with gold, a gold death mask with two dark eye holes, a tall striped blue-and-gold headdress hanging to the shoulders, a broad gold collar on the chest, holding one gold sceptre with a hooked top in the hand on the right side of the image in every cell; centred in its own cell with empty space on both sides. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: the gold death mask with two dark eye holes.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, turned three-quarters toward the heroes on the right and leaning his body far forward to the right, raising the sceptre upright in front of his chest with both hands, the sceptre vertical (not pointed forward), its hooked top level with the headdress, the whole sceptre well inside the middle cell; nothing reaches back to the left, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back to the left, the masked head tilted back, the free hand flung up, the sceptre upright in the same hand, the headdress on the head as in the idle cell, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Use a clear diagonal line of action through the whole body, shift the weight onto one leg, lean the torso toward the heroes and thrust the sceptre and free hand with the elbows bent, so every reaching part stays well inside its own cell. Draw only the parts and clothing named in the description, the same in every cell: no cape, cloak or extra cloth, and no spell effects, smear or motion lines. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, standing on two feet, both feet on the ground line. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, a hunched pose, loose trailing bandages, a crown, a sword, a skull face, a cape, a second sceptre.
